name: prompt-queue
description: Queue messages you send while Claude works and send them one at a time when each turn finishes, Cursor-style. An editable, reorderable queue above the prompt, with disabled todo items, and a queue, steer or interrupt send mode.

defaultMode.title: Default send mode
defaultMode.description: What Enter does while Claude is working: queue (send after the turn), steer (inject after the next tool call), interrupt (stop the turn and send now). ctrl+x enter does the other of queue and steer once.

showModeInFooter.title: Show send mode in footer
showModeInFooter.description: Show the current send mode (queue, steer or interrupt) among the mode labels in the footer under the prompt
